description: Product Name: Power BI Waterfall Visualization Object Version: 1.0.0 Release date: November 22, 2024 Developer: [Infortime] Product Description: This product is an advanced visualization object designed specifically for Power BI users. It utilizes the powerful features of Baidu ECharts to provide users with an intuitive and interactive waterfall display method. A waterfall chart is a special type of chart used to display the cumulative effect of data, particularly suitable for displaying financial data such as changes in revenue, expenses, and profits. Main functions: Data driven visualization: Users can directly drive waterfall charts through Power BI's data model to achieve dynamic data display. Highly customizable: Provides multiple customization options, including color, font, legend position, etc., to meet the display needs of different users. Interactivity: Supports interactive operations such as mouse hovering and clicking, enhancing user experience. Responsive design: Waterfall charts can adapt to different display devices and resolutions. Multi language support: Supports multiple languages to meet the needs of global users. Usage scenario: Financial analysis: Display the cumulative effect of a company's revenue, expenses, and profits. Budget tracking: Track the allocation and utilization of the budget.
